payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP counting sequences where each step is either a red flower or a block of k white flowers; dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-k] with prefix sums for range queries.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single array arr[length] and recurrence arr[i]=arr[i-1]+arr[i-k] (with base cases), clearly a 1-dimensional state DP.
